data.name: Fatimaeh
data.gender_notes: Fatimaeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatimaeh is derived from the Arabic word 'Fatimah' which means 'chaste, pure'. The name Fatimaeh carries the meaning “Chaste, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatimaeh usually hope their child will grow to embody chaste, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatimaeh was the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Khadija (R.A). She was known for her piety, generosity and kindness.
data.etymology: Fatimaeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chaste, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatimaeh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فاطمہ
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فاطمہ رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہا، ایک پاکیزہ اور جدا شدہ نام
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو حضرت فاطمہ زہرا رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہا کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹی تھیں۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے 'وہ جو شر و فساد سے بچا لی گئی ہے' یا 'پاکیزہ'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اکثر مسلمان لڑکیوں کو دیا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ پاکیزگی اور تقوی کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: فاطمہ نام معنی پاکیزہ، علیحدہ، خاموش اور محفوظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جو کہ فاطمہ بنت رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی نسبت سے ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو برائی سے محفوظ ہو یا پاکیزہ۔ یہ نام اسلامی دنیا میں خاص طور پر اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ فاطمہ زہرا رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہا رسول اللہ کی بیٹی تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: फातिमा
in_hindi.meaning: फातिमा नाम का अर्थ है पवित्र, शुद्ध और बुराई से मुक्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिमा नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद की बेटी हज़रत फातिमा ज़हरा से जुड़ा है। इस नाम का अर्थ है 'पवित्र' या 'बुराई से मुक्त'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी बहुत लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर लड़कियों को दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فاطمه
in_pashto.meaning: فاطمه نوم مطلب پاکيزه، جلا او خوندي شوې
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاطمه نوم د اسلامي نړۍ په کښلې ډېر اهميت لری، دا د حضرت فاطمہ زهرا نوم دی چې د رسول الله صلی الله علیه وسلم لور وه. دا نوم د 'پاکيزه' يا 'هغه څوک چې د شر څخه بچول شوې' معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونخوا کې، دا نوم ډېر استعمالېږي.

in_english.name: Fatimaeh
in_english.meaning: Fatimaeh means pure, abstained or one who is free from evil
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatimaeh originates from the Arabic name Fatimah, which means 'one who abstains' or 'pure'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'f-t-m', which conveys the idea of weaning or abstaining. In Islamic tradition, Fatimah was the name of the Prophet Muhammad's daughter, who embodied purity and spiritual excellence. The name Fatimaeh symbolizes innocence, modesty, and spiritual purity, making it a popular choice among Muslim parents worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: Fatimaeh is a popular female name in the Islamic world, that originated from Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) beloved daughter, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWS) and Khadijah (RA), named Fatimah bint Muhammad. The name is deeply rooted in Islamic culture and history, making it significant for Muslim families who wish to honor their religious heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Fatimah Zahra (AS), the Prophet Muhammad's (SAWS) daughter, is considered a model of purity and obedience to Allah. The name Fatimaeh is a reminder of this spiritual significance and inspires those who bear the name to embody the virtues of purity, chastity, and devotion to Allah. Additionally, Fatimah Zahra (AS) is also revered for her strong spiritual connection to her father, and the name can serve as a reminder of the importance of deep bond with one's parents and loved ones. The name Fatimaeh can serve as a reminder to lead a life of moral righteousness, charged with spiritual meaning, and a deep sense of devotion to Allah.

islamic_reference.note: Daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), "leader of women in Paradise"

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fatima bint Muhammad (605-632 CE) was the youngest and most beloved wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Fatimaeh carried significant weight in that era.
She is also known as Umm Al-Hasan and Umm Al-Husayn, as she is the mother of Hasan and Husayn, the grandsons of the Prophet Muhammad.
